name: Bark Out
author: jdaviee
description: Step into the shoes of the villains! "Bark Out" is a modernized version of the classic game Break Out in which with every block you destroy you are actually destroying the forest and all its natural beauty! Collect toxic barrels to get special power ups but beware of the falling fruit for they will have the opposite affect. Diversifiers: Language Independence, Sustainability. Team Members : Anders Christensen, James Davies, Daniel Gruescu
